title: Hadith on Recitation and Helping Others
summary: The Hadith describes the rewards for reciting the Quran and helping others.
translation: Reciting the Quran is not only a virtuous act but also brings immense benefits and goodness. While it earns rewards for the hereafter, one worldly benefit is that angels surround the reciter's home, calmness descends upon it, divine mercy covers it, and Allah mentions them among the angels close to Him. This is narrated in Sahih Muslim from Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) where the Prophet (peace be upon him) shared important guidance for us. One teaching is that whoever alleviates a believer's worldly distress, Allah will alleviate their distress on the Day of Judgment. Also, whoever eases the burden of a debtor, Allah will ease burdens for them in this world and in the hereafter, and whoever conceals another’s faults, Allah will conceal their faults in this world and the hereafter. Allah is in the aid of His servant as long as the servant is aiding their brother. Additionally, whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes a path to Paradise easy for them. Those who gather in Allah's houses to recite and study His Book are enveloped in tranquility, covered in mercy, surrounded by angels, and Allah speaks of them to those close to Him. Furthermore, it states that if one’s deeds slow them down, their lineage will not speed them up, emphasizing that success is based on personal actions, not one's lineage or status.
